mcat_description.short: Roofing Sheet Fabrication is a construction service covering the supply, cutting, profiling, and on-site installation of metal roofing sheets — including GI corrugated, colour-coated profile, PUF sandwich panels, and aluminium sheets — for industrial sheds, warehouses, and commercial or residential roofs. Contractors quote the service per square foot of covered area.
mcat_description.long: Roofing Sheet Fabrication encompasses the end-to-end service of procuring, roll-forming or cutting to size, and erecting metal roofing sheets on structural frameworks for industrial, commercial, and residential buildings. The dominant materials are Galvanized Iron (GI) corrugated sheets conforming to IS 277, colour-coated pre-painted galvanized (PPGI) or galvalume (PPGL) profile sheets, and PUF (polyurethane foam) sandwich panels for insulated roofing. Fabricators typically handle the full scope — supply of sheets from major mills (JSW, Tata, Jindal), custom cutting to project dimensions, purlin/fastener supply, and installation — with the service quoted per square foot of roof area. The MCAT sits within the Prefabricated Structures and Industrial Sheds taxonomy, reflecting its primary buyer base of shed builders, industrial contractors, and facility owners commissioning new or replacement roofing.

market_context: Roofing Sheet Fabrication in the Indian B2B market refers primarily to a contractor service — the supply, custom cutting, and on-site installation of metal roofing sheets for industrial sheds, warehouses, and commercial or residential buildings. The dominant materials are GI corrugated sheets (conforming to IS 277 for galvanized steel), colour-coated pre-painted galvanized (PPGI) and galvalume (PPGL) profile sheets, and PUF sandwich panels for insulated roofing. GI sheets are hot-dip zinc-coated (typically Z-90 to Z-275 GSM) and available in thicknesses of 0.20mm–2.5mm, with standard roofing thickness at 0.45mm–0.60mm. Profile types include corrugated (sinusoidal), trapezoidal, box profile, and tile/Mangalore profile. Major Indian steel mill brands — JSW, Tata Roofseal, Jindal — are the dominant raw material sources. PUF sandwich panels (10mm–100mm thickness) are a growing sub-segment driven by insulation and soundproofing demand, as evidenced by call data showing 10 of 17 buyer enquiries mentioning PUF sheets. Kerala-type and Mangalore tile profile sheets represent a regional design preference in South India, surfacing prominently in Google keyword data. The service is quoted per square foot of covered area; material-only supply is quoted per kg. Buyers are primarily industrial shed contractors, PEB contractors, and facility owners; sellers are fabricators who source sheets from major mills and provide end-to-end installation.
